answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond of earned POA before it can trade, like a falcon that must first climb out of a canyon on its own wings: the bond is quartz-hard collateral, not a password. A fake identity costs the full bond to create, and proven fraud slashes it, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds while honest work earns the bond back with interest. Attackers pay upfront for every clone; defenders pay nothing extra.
